raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Split from #44309 (adapter-state fixes stay there). The LoRA merge cache could serve stale merged weights and mishandle several paths.

## Changes

- Key on the resolved local adapter file (name, resolved name, size, mtime, inode) plus the per-adapter effective alpha and loaded PEFT config, so an alpha change, `use_rslora` or `alpha_pattern` edit, or a different file from the same repo gets its own store. Bare module names no longer resolve against the cwd.
- The cache merge runs once after all adapters are set, so it also covers layers the last adapter skips.
- A failed `put()` removes only its temp file, not the previous entry.
- Admission evicts least recently used stores when disk headroom is short; adopting a store marks it recently used.

## Tests

No new files. Extended `test_lora_merge_cache.py` and `test_lora_pipeline.py` (existing CPU-backed cache test now asserts key identity). The 3 new/extended tests fail on `main` and pass here, plus a deterministic low-space eviction test.

Modal CPU, LoRA unit files: 65 passed in the targeted run. ruff, isort, codespell clean. No GPU run.

 def lora_merge_cache_key(
     base_paths: list[str],
     adapters: list[tuple[str, float, float | None]],
+    fingerprints: list[tuple[int, int] | None] | None = None,
 ) -> str:
     """Key of one merged-weights combination.
 
     `base_paths` are the component checkpoint paths (HF snapshot paths carry
     the revision hash); `adapters` are ordered (lora_path, strength, alpha)
     triples — order matters, merges compose in order. Include adapter file
     modification times so same-size local checkpoint updates invalidate the cache.
+    `fingerprints` are optional (size, mtime_ns) snapshots taken when each adapter
+    was loaded; they replace the merge-time stat so a file replaced after loading
+    cannot be cached under the replacement's identity.
     """
     parts = [os.path.realpath(p) for p in sorted(base_paths)]
-    for path, strength, alpha in adapters:
+    for i, (path, strength, alpha) in enumerate(adapters):
         real = os.path.realpath(path)
-        try:
-            stat = os.stat(real)
-            size, mtime_ns = stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns
-        except OSError:
-            size, mtime_ns = -1, -1
+        snapshot = fingerprints[i] if fingerprints else None
+        if snapshot is not None:
+            size, mtime_ns = snapshot
+        else:
+            try:
+                stat = os.stat(real)
+                size, mtime_ns = stat.st_size, stat.st_mtime_ns

+                size, mtime_ns = -1, -1

     return hashlib.sha1("||".join(parts).encode()).hexdigest()[:16]

The key helper stats this pathname at merge time, so replacing a local adapter after loading can cache the old delta under the replacement’s identity and serve stale weights on the next startup. Use the load-time identity or disable caching when it changes, and cover this with a load/replace/merge/reload regression.
